name: Bradley A. Evens
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Mercer Island, Washington
about: Mr. Evens is a founding partner at Bucklin Evens PLLC, and concentrates his practice on family law. This includes pre- and post-marital agreements, dissolution and legal separation, cohabitation relationships, parenting issues, child and spousal support, complex property issues including issues related to business ownership, retirement assets, stock options and other employee benefits, and post-decree modifications and adjustments of support and parenting orders. The balance of Mr. Evens’ practice encompasses estate planning and preparation of wills, trusts and other planning documents. Mr. Evens is a former partner of the Seattle firm of Short Cressman & Burgess PLLC, and a former associate of Foster Pepper PLLC. Mr. Evens graduated from Connecticut College in 1990 and obtained his J.D. at Tulane University School of Law in 1993. Mr. Evens recently celebrated his 25th anniversary as a member of the Washington State Bar Association.
